findings.defect: The new test helper unconditionally uses std::os::unix::fs::symlink, preventing the local-feature test target from compiling on Windows. Gate the helper and its dependent tests to Unix, or provide a platform-specific implementation.
findings.scenario: On Windows, run `cargo test -p rb-embed --features local --no-run`. Compilation fails because `std::os::unix` is unavailable, so none of the crate's tests can run.
